title: Quran 3:104 in Sahih International calls for a community that enjoins right and forbids wrong
summary: Sahih International of Quran 3:104 calls for enjoining right and forbidding wrong.
body: Sahih International of Quran 3:104 says there should be a community inviting to good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong. The phrase is a Quranic duty. Schools differ on who holds it and how far it reaches. The wording on the page includes: "And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful.". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
